name: scientific-agent-skills
description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 175,000+ scientists worldwide. 163 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
one_liner: A giant plug-in pack of ready-made science skills and databases that turns a general AI assistant into a specialized lab research assistant.
buyer: A biotech startup founder who can't yet afford a full bioinformatics team but needs to run standard analyses.
business_use_cases: A small biotech lab automates literature review and standard bioinformatics pipelines instead of hiring a specialist.
A university lab gives every grad student instant access to 100+ scientific databases through one agent.
A pharma consultancy offers 'AI research assistant setup' as a service to smaller labs.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid onboarding/customization for labs that want the skill set tailored to their specific workflows.
Run a hosted, managed version with usage-based billing for compute-heavy database queries.

steal_this: Spin up an 'AI Scientist as a service' consulting offer this weekend: install and configure this for a small lab for a flat setup fee.
